content.rendered:
During the second CCRA Breakfast Meeting on June 19th Vicki, N6KLS led a discussion on membership requirements and dues structures.  Gene, WW6H and Steve, WA6HAM provided some background information on earlier requirements that the group had used in the past.  This information provided the group an opportunity to look at the membership requirements with a historical perspective.  It was stressed that just because we had certain membership requirements in the past, it wasn’t necessary for us to continue those same membership requirements in the future.

To find out more information about what happened at the June 19th meeting please check out our soon to be released Vol. 1, Issue 1 July issue of the “Contra Costa Repeater Association WA6HAM Newsletter”.

Thanks to everyone for attending the June Breakfast!
